python3 - <<'EOF'
import os, re
root = "src"
hits = []
for dp, dn, fns in os.walk(root):
    for f in sorted(fns):
        if not f.endswith(".rs"): continue
        p = os.path.join(dp, f)
        lines = open(p, errors="replace").read().splitlines()
        intest = False
        depth = 0
        for i, l in enumerate(lines):
            s = l.strip()
            if re.match(r'#\[cfg\(test\)\]', s): intest = True
            if intest and s.startswith('}') and depth == 0:
                pass
            if re.search(r'\.(unwrap|expect)\(\s*\)|panic!|unimplemented!|todo!|unreachable!', l) and not s.startswith('//'):
                fn = ''
                for j in range(i, max(-1, i-40), -1):
                    m = re.match(r'\s*(?:pub(?:\([^)]*\))?\s+)?(?:async\s+)?fn\s+(\w+)', lines[j])
                    if m: fn = m.group(1); break
                hits.append((p, i+1, fn, intest, s[:140]))
print(f"TOTAL_HITS={len(hits)}")
prod = [h for h in hits if not h[3]]
print(f"PROD_CONTEXT_HITS={len(prod)}")
for h in prod: print("PROD", h)
EOF
